gordian_traps.name: Isolated Agents Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Built N vehicles with separate Historization on same topology. Four commits fixing symptoms (epistemic trust, surprise dampening, adaptive observation) instead of cause.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Competition test instead of cooperation. Leitsystem concept introduced but not watched through implementation.
gordian_traps.lesson: When agents share a domain, check first: do they share knowledge? Multiverse infrastructure (C60-68) exists for exactly this.

gordian_traps.name: Blind Trust Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: All adversarial defenses trusted the Outcome signal. Injection attacks succeeded 3/3. C243b: openai_call trusted LLM response without checking finish_reason — truncated JSON silently passed to parser.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Defense-in-depth only at edge level, not at outcome level. Same pattern at API boundary: trusted response completeness without verification.
gordian_traps.resolution: C173 structural skepticism (partial), C174 self-honesty (partial). C243b: finish_reason check + LLMTruncatedError + diagnostics logging.
gordian_traps.lesson: Any signal E₀ relies on can be poisoned. Always ask: what if this signal lies? Applies to ALL boundaries — including API responses.

gordian_traps.name: Greedy Matching Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Six commits improving features (4-dim→9-dim, edge→node, context scoring) gained only +9. Matching was the actual bottleneck. C243b: 3+ iterations improving JSON parsing instead of checking upstream signal (finish_reason).
gordian_traps.root_cause: Assumed feature quality drove accuracy. Mutual-best matching causes cascading errors — one wrong pair poisons neighbors.
gordian_traps.resolution: C137: Hungarian optimal assignment → 44/44 immediately. C243b: checked upstream → max_tokens was the real bottleneck.
gordian_traps.lesson: When incremental improvements stall, the bottleneck may not be where you think. Step back and question the pipeline.

gordian_traps.name: Distance Collapse Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Dictionary bootstrap saturates: distances converge to 1, discrimination lost, wrong pairs accumulate votes.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Adding entries changes the landscape, which changes all distances. Feedback loop collapses the signal.
gordian_traps.resolution: Level-3 neighborhood consistency (C128) gates promotion by structural context.
gordian_traps.lesson: Self-modifying systems can destroy their own discrimination signal. Monitor signal quality, not just accuracy.

gordian_traps.name: Amplitude Override Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Amplitude overlay overrides greedy's revisit-penalty correction on loop domains. Greedy escapes siren loops in 11 steps; amplitude keeps the controller permanently trapped (60 steps, 0% goal rate).
gordian_traps.root_cause: Amplitude maximizes intensity within bounded horizon. Siren loops have low S_eff → high intensity → amplitude AGREES the loop is a good path and overrides greedy's learned correction.
gordian_traps.resolution: C193: Two-layer defense. (1) Revisit-aware override gate: amplitude cannot override to _recent states when self-graph is present — prevents Historization corruption. (2) Self-graph override self-loop: amplitude→amplitude edge accumulates U/F on override events, providing learned long-term quality signal. Gate: override_quality < 0 → block. Self-graph is the trigger: without self-reflection, GT-5 persists by design.
gordian_traps.lesson: A mechanism that helps in one domain (dead-end traps) can HURT in another (loop traps). Integration value is domain-dependent. Self-reflection (self-graph) is required for the system to detect its own harmful patterns.

gordian_traps.name: Default Blast Radius Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Set auto_detect=True as default in build_session(). Broke 30 tests. Brute-forced auto_detect=False into 100+ test calls instead of questioning the design.
gordian_traps.root_cause: New behavior as default forces all callers to opt out. Correct pattern: new behavior off by default, entry points opt in. Recognized during the fix cascade but not stopped — GT-3 recurrence.
gordian_traps.resolution: C225 amend: auto_detect=False default, True only in run_interactive() and run_server(). Zero test changes needed.
gordian_traps.lesson: New features default OFF, entry points opt IN. When fixing a break causes >10 edits to unrelated code, stop and question the default.

gordian_traps.name: Coherent Domain Error
gordian_traps.what_happened: Used string prefixes (C:, EN:, M:, B:, L:) as architectural domain boundaries for 22 commits. Dream, Sleep-Wake, Tune, Curriculum, Diagnostics all partitioned by prefix. Dream and CouplingRouter implemented the same operation (structural resonance between subgraphs) with different non-E₀-native partitioning. Symptoms surfaced in C253 (teach→ask disconnect) and C254 (dream dead-end).
gordian_traps.root_cause: Imposed E₂-level semantic categories (domain labels) as E₀-level structural primitives. Violates domain invariance and self-similarity. E₀ canon explicitly says: 'E₀ is not a theory of objects, meanings, goals, agents, or domains.' The error was coherent (internally consistent across 22 commits) which made it hard to detect.
gordian_traps.resolution: C255-C262 Emergent Structure arc: community detection from R_eff (Historization-derived). Macro systems (Dream, Sleep-Wake, Diagnostics) migrated. Post-arc audit revealed micro level (teach bridges, navigation crossing) still prefix-based — addressed in C263-C267 Micro-Level Emergence arc.
gordian_traps.lesson: Coherent errors are the hardest to find because each commit is individually correct. E₀'s own dynamics expose them: the symptoms (teach→ask disconnect, dream dead-end, Dream≠Coupling asymmetry) are the system telling us the assumption is wrong. When two subsystems do the same thing differently, question the partitioning, not the subsystems.

gordian_traps.name: Partial Residual Trap
gordian_traps.when: C290+ (identified 2026-04-29, not yet manifested as a bug)
gordian_traps.what_happened: PARTIAL outcome is defined in primitives.py and handled in historization.py (U += 0.5, F += 0.3). Used in domain_invoice.py and benchmark_domain_invariance.py. The signal is operationally correct but structurally incomplete: when a transition produces PARTIAL, the unresolved remainder of the structural difference is silently discarded. E0 historizes the edge but does not create a new Difference object for the residual. The system may then reach a state where Delta=0 nominally (goal state reached) while real structural difference persists outside the model.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Transitions in E0 are binary (they happen or they don't) but the degree of difference reduction is not. PARTIAL was introduced as a runtime convenience to express 'partial resolution', but the architecture has no channel to carry the residual forward. The rest disappears — it is neither a new node/edge in the landscape, nor a trigger for Dream or Multiverse exploration. The 0.5/0.3 weights are empirical (not canon-derived) and create a slight positive bias with no structural justification.
gordian_traps.resolution: Not yet resolved. Candidate: a 'Partial Difference Residual' mechanism — PARTIAL outcome creates a new Difference in the landscape rather than historizing the edge alone. Alternatively: explicit residual tracking in SessionState that Dream mode can consume.
gordian_traps.lesson: When a system introduces a third outcome value (beyond the binary canon), ask: where does the unresolved remainder go? If the answer is 'nowhere' — the architecture is incomplete. Graduation of outcome is not the same as graduation of resolution.

breakthroughs.name: Hungarian Matching
breakthroughs.insight: Feature engineering is NOT the bottleneck — matching strategy is. Global optimal assignment avoids cascading errors from greedy matching.

breakthroughs.name: Shared Historization
breakthroughs.insight: Cooperation effect SCALES with congestion. Shared knowledge prevents problems before they happen. coop+adapt = plain coop (shared hist already prevents surprises).

breakthroughs.name: Epistemic Liveness
breakthroughs.insight: F=0 traps the system forever — greedy never escapes (proved with 10k steps). Zweifel zuzulassen (allowing doubt) is structurally necessary, not a flaw.

breakthroughs.name: Dual Nature of Integration
breakthroughs.insight: Integration value is trap-type dependent. Dead-end traps: amplitude provides 2x improvement. Loop traps: amplitude HURTS without self-reflection. Self-graph enables self-correction. No single layer dominates all domains.

breakthroughs.name: Trajectory-Level Epistemic Liveness
breakthroughs.insight: A fixed trajectory shape traps the system at the round level — analogous to BT-3 at edge level. TrajectoryHistorization makes the path pattern an object that can be doubted. plan() gains a non-Markov signal: the decision depends on the history of trajectory shapes, not just current state. F4 gap partially closed: E₀ now has proactive pattern-escape, not just reactive stagnation detection.

breakthroughs.name: Conviction-Gated Quantum Walk
breakthroughs.insight: Quantumness is not a fixed parameter — it emerges from Historization. conviction(e)=(m/(m+mu))*|q| gates the SU(2) coin angle. Virgin/conflicted edges stay quantum; confirmed edges collapse toward classical. The quantum->classical transition is earned, not scheduled. scale_su2(C, s) interpolates SU(2) rotations continuously in [Identity, C].

breakthroughs.name: FileSensor as E2-Boundary Read
breakthroughs.insight: File upload is World → E₀ (data IN), not E₀ → World (action OUT). FileSensor lives at the E₂ boundary as a READ-only sensor. Three input formats (CSV/JSON/text) with a single inject() auto-detect entry point. Topology and Historization are additive and independent: Schema B (DomainSpec) builds topology with zero inscriptions; CSV/JSON/traces build both. Enables the Learn/Apply two-phase pattern: upload historical data → Landscape pre-trained before first live episode.

perspective_checks._comment: Our Amplitude Override. Questions that force perspective shifts before committing to an approach. Update 'triggered' when a check actually catches something.

checks.question: Are agents sharing knowledge or isolated? If isolated — is that intentional?
Am I testing what I think I'm testing? (Competition vs. Cooperation)
Which existing infrastructure (Multiverse, Dream, Curriculum, Sleep-Wake) applies here but isn't being used?
If incremental improvements stall after 3+ commits, is the bottleneck where I think it is?
If this test fails — what do I learn? If nothing — redesign the test.
Am I fixing the right problem, or building around a wrong assumption?
What if this signal lies? (Outcome, quality, distance — any input can be poisoned)
Am I hedging or deciding? If >2 caveats — cut to 1 and commit to a position.
If fixing a break requires >10 edits to unrelated code — am I fixing the right thing, or should the default change?
If I migrated the macro level to mechanism X — does the micro level still use mechanism Y? Two partitioning worlds = incomplete migration.
Does the paper still match the code? If a formula or default changed since the paper was written, the paper is stale — not the code.
If a transition produces PARTIAL — where does the unresolved structural difference go? If the answer is 'nowhere', the architecture is incomplete (GT-8).

Is this new primitive operable on two levels? Can E₀ navigate a landscape of X AND a landscape of paths-through-X with the same operators? If no — document why. (MetaLandscape / self-similarity check)

structural_entropy._comment: Our forgetting protocol. Isomorphic to E₀'s structural entropy (C114-C121). Prevents bootstrap.json from growing without bound. structural_entropy.prune_log_C318: pressure = 35/(35+30) ≈ 0.54 > 0.5 → triggered. Actions: removed duplicate MetaLandscape perspective_check; removed IB-1.5 (done C312). No section exceeded 2×μ — no aggressive removal. Updated all stale state fields (state, active_context, commit_history_recent).

commit_history_recent.anchor_rule: Keep last 30 + any entry referenced by reflexion, perspective_checks, or active_context. Decay rest (git log is permanent source).

gordian_traps.anchor_rule: anchor_score = recurred + (referenced_by_perspective_check ? 1 : 0). Keep if recurred > 0 in last 30 commits OR resolution < 50 commits old. Lesson migrates to perspective_checks before removal.

breakthroughs.anchor_rule: anchor_score = built_upon. Keep if built_upon > 0. If built_upon = 0 after 30 commits → was it really a breakthrough?

perspective_checks.anchor_rule: anchor_score = triggered. Keep if triggered > 0. If triggered = 0 after 30 commits → reformulate or remove.

working_principles.anchor_rule: anchor_score = |q| × m (clarity × experience). High |q| + high m → anchor. q ≈ 0 with high m → confused, reformulate. Low m → too fresh for decay.

open_threads.anchor_rule: Keep if actionable (next arc target) or actively informing current work. Closed threads → remove. Bloated threads → compress to 2-3 sentences.

key_formulas.effective_resistance: R_eff(e) = R₀(e) + δ_H(U,F) [or δ_H·trust(e) when epistemic_trust=True]
key_formulas.navigation: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) (greedy with overlap+inertia), with amplitude override when Δ·conf > threshold
key_formulas.graduated_overlap: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))), greedy divides S_eff by M_H
key_formulas.inertia_factor: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|), greedy divides S_eff by I

Lazy-decay formula (K2 — ρ^(τ−τ_last)): if the formula changes, update traces.py._effective_traces() and traces.py.update() catch-up logic. Re-run acceptance test T3.

Outcome.PARTIAL weights (U+=0.5, F+=0.3): if changed in historization.py, update traces.py.update() PARTIAL branch. GT-8 (Partial Residual Trap) is documented in both bootstrap.json and E0_LEAN_CORE.md §4.
Epistemic trust formula (trust=exp(−staleness/τ_doubt), stability, τ_base): if formula changes, update traces.py.trust() and traces.py.stability(). Re-run T4, T5.
Surprise dampening + classify_experience thresholds (rate<0.3=stable, ≥0.3=volatile, events<3=exploratory): if thresholds change, update traces.py.classify_experience(). Re-run T6.
Modules EXCLUDED from lean core (amplitude, SU(2), dream, multiverse, self-graph, NoveltyGate, PathSignature, curriculum, sleep-wake): changes to these do NOT affect lean/.

key_modules_quick_ref.controller.py: E0Controller(landscape, execute_fn, *, hybrid_goals=None, peer_fn=None, overload_threshold=3.0, focus_k=None). run(start, goal, max_steps=50) → RunTrace. focus_k: random narrows candidates, peer bypasses filter (C82). _penalized_tension divides S_eff by M_H when landscape.overlap_modulation=True (C98), by inertia_factor when landscape.inertia_modulation=True (C99).
key_modules_quick_ref.landscape.py: Landscape dataclass. add_state(), add_edge(src,tgt,delta,resistance), remove_edge(), adjust_delta(), adjust_base_resistance(), .states (property→Set), .edges (property→List[Edge]), .edge_count(), .difference(), .effective_resistance(), .effective_tension(), .historization (Historization instance)
key_modules_quick_ref.multiverse.py: Universe(name, landscape, execute_fn, start, goal). MultiverseController(a, b). NoveltyGate. LandscapeSnapshot.
key_modules_quick_ref.coupling_router.py: CouplingReason(RECOVERY|EXPLORATION). CouplingRouter(universes, coupling_weights={...}). select_partner(requester, reason). historize(src,tgt,outcome,weight_mod_active,distance_mod_active). set_weight(). self_graph=CouplingSelfGraph(). CouplingSelfGraph: self_historize(), component_quality/load/inertia(), diagnose_coupling(csg)→CouplingDiagnosis. make_routed_peer_fn(router, requester, goal).
key_modules_quick_ref.cross_reflexion.py: cross_propose_edges(landscape, donor, current, goal, coupling_discount=0.5, scoped=False) → CrossReflexionResult. scoped=True (C107): donor pattern from donor's scope, discount modulated by ℓ_donor. scoped_cross_reflexion_turn(): convenience TurnFn.

key_modules_quick_ref.server/models.py: 12 Pydantic models for API validation: CreateSessionRequest/Response, StartRequest, SessionInfo, StepEventModel, WSMessage, CanonSummary, StrategyEntry, HealthResponse.
key_modules_quick_ref.server/main.py: FastAPI app (E₀ Framework API v0.8.0). Mounts router + WebSocket at /sessions/{id}/ws. Start: py -3 -m uvicorn server.main:app --reload
key_modules_quick_ref.service.py: ServiceSession(landscape, execute_fn, peer_bridge=). start/step/run_sync/pause/resume/snapshot/strategy. SessionManager: create_from_json/text/canon/landscape, get, remove, list_sessions. StepEvent: single event contract per cycle.
key_modules_quick_ref.snapshot_codec.py: encode_landscape/decode_landscape roundtrip. encode_step, encode_run_trace, encode_strategy_profile, encode_edge_info.
key_modules_quick_ref.peer_bridge.py: PeerBridge(session_id, timeout=60). as_peer_fn() → sync callback. submit_response(target). is_waiting, pending_request.
key_modules_quick_ref.observation.py: ObservationLandscape(landscape, depth=2). focus(node_id), move(node_id), defocus(). project() → subgraph dict. Scoped navigable projection of any E₀ Landscape.
key_modules_quick_ref.observation_controller.py: ObservationController(session). navigate(action, node_id). snapshot() → GraphView-compatible dict. meta_snapshot() → scope/depth/focus state.
key_modules_quick_ref.rendering_adapter.py: render_observation(obs_ctrl) → dict with Cytoscape elements. Wraps under 'landscape' key for GraphView compatibility.
key_modules_quick_ref.e0_session.py: run_session(task, start, goal, canon, save) → SessionResult. CLI: py -3 -m e0_controller.e0_session --task '...'. Full pipeline: LLM-derived endpoints → Controller → Perception → Intent → UISpec → HTML. _derive_endpoints() calls LLM when start/goal not provided. Mock mode: _mock_derive_endpoints().
key_modules_quick_ref.perception.py: PerceptionOntology — Gestalt primitives (proximity, emphasis, hierarchy, ...) as landscape domain. render_perception(controller_state) → PerceptionSnapshot.
key_modules_quick_ref.communication.py: CommunicationIntent — detect_intents(controller_state, perception) → list[Intent]. Maps internal state to human-facing communication goals.
key_modules_quick_ref.ui_emitter.py: UISchemaEmitter — emit(intents, perception) → UISpec. Combines intent and perception into structured UI specification.
key_modules_quick_ref.ui_renderer.py: render_ui(ui_spec) → str (HTML). Stateless rendering of UISpec to standalone HTML document.
key_modules_quick_ref.visual_pretraining.py: LLM-based rendering selection. pretrain_rendering(domain) evaluates visual options. Memo persistence for learned preferences.
